title: w3c-hr-time is deprecated
summary: npm directs users of w3c-hr-time to native performance.now() and performance.timeOrigin.

constraints: Preserve monotonic timing, time-origin assumptions, units, precision expectations, and minimum-runtime support.

steps.title: Use native high-resolution time
steps.instructions: Replace w3c-hr-time imports and clock reads with native performance.now() and performance.timeOrigin, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run timing behavior and repository tests without relying on exact wall-clock values.
